title: Elvis Presley paid $437,000 for 163 acres in Mississippi in 1967; the ranch he used for riding became known as Circle G | Hindustan Times
text:
How a Christmas horse led to a ranch
The trail began in late 1966. Elvis got serious about horses by December 5 and bought riding clothes and gear, according to the timeline. He got Priscilla a horse on December 20 for a Christmas present. The National Register of Historic Places registration form for Circle G Ranch says the ranch grew out of this horse-buying business. It names a four-year-old black quarter horse called Domino as Priscilla’s horse. She didn’t want to ride alone, so Elvis bought himself a palomino called Rising Sun. Then he started buying horses for everyone around him, and the form says the stable soon outgrew Graceland. The same document says that Priscilla remembered seeing the ranch one morning in February 1967 as she drove by Horn Lake, Mississippi. There were cattle and a little lake with a bridge and a barn with horse stalls. And it was for sale.
